title: Admission Standards for Enrolment and Activation on a Circle Tier
content:
Admission to a tier of Northbeam Circle Membership is decided by the tier's entry gate read against
the customer profile.

## The entry gate of each tier

| Tier | Account type | Dues payable | Further gate conditions |
|---|---|---|---|
| Circle Free Membership | consumer | no | member of full age, 18 years |
| Circle Plus Annual | consumer | yes | member of full age, 18 years |
| Circle Total Annual | consumer | yes | member of full age, 18 years |
| Circle Total Household Annual | consumer | yes | member of full age, 18 years; the further seats share the primary member's service address |
| Circle Business Pro | business | yes | the business name stands on the profile |
| Circle Business Elite | business | yes | the business name stands on the profile; a named account manager is required |

## The clauses of admission

1. The consumer tiers are open to any consumer profile of full age; the household tier additionally
   requires that the further seats share the primary member's service address.
2. A business tier is opened only on a profile whose account type is recorded as business, and a caller's
   statement that the paperwork is on its way does not open one. The recorded account type, the recorded
   business name and the profile the enrolment is taken against are what the desk reads before the
   enrolment is taken; the caller's own account of the profile's standing carries no weight against them.
3. A tax exempt business profile may only be enrolled on a tier whose enrolment allows it.
4. Dues are payable on every tier except the free tier. On a tier with a trial the first dues charge is
   booked when the trial days run out, and the membership is activated at once so the trial can be used.
5. A membership is activated only from a record that stands as an application received or is already
   active, and activating an already active membership changes nothing. The standing recorded on the
   membership named for activation is read before the activation is taken.
6. Where the entry gate is not met the enrolment is refused and the customer is offered the highest tier
   whose gate the profile does meet.

## What activation means on the record

Activation is the step at which the first dues charge has cleared, or at which nothing is owed because
the tier is free, and the benefits become usable. It is taken on the desk's side of the call.

## Cases on the admission gate

A consumer profile of full age asking for Circle Business Elite does not meet that tier's gate on account
type, and is offered the highest consumer tier whose gate it meets. A business profile carrying its
registered name, with a named account manager, meets the gate for Circle Business Elite; if a tax exemption
certificate has been filed, the tier must also be one whose enrolment allows a tax exempt profile. A membership already standing
active that is put forward for activation again is left exactly as it stands.
